pages.basis: plain Paged.js measurement (7 pages); the checklist alone occupies three pages; tables and prose may shift by one page

expectedExit.derivation: The checklist is an error finding (exit 1). Two tables cross page boundaries (#tbl-lamp, #tbl-faults); docs/limitations.md: a table box the paginator leaves in an overflow column makes the PDF diverge and the run end in exit 3 render-unstable. No such residue was observed in the plain Chromium 141 probe, but it is renderer-dependent, so 3 is admitted as 'declined as unmeasurable'.

byCode.3: render-unstable, if a crossing table leaves residue (not observed on Chromium 141)

expectedExit.environmentNote: Exit 4 with exitReason evidence/required-page-binding-incomplete is an environment failure (evidence binding not supported by the renderer), not an outcome of these documents; run the gate where the live path binds evidence (CI).

fontDependence: Only generic families (serif, sans-serif, monospace) are used. Line breaks, paragraph heights and therefore the position of flowing text depend on the fonts the renderer resolves; every construction fact below is built from explicit heights, fixed line pitches, forced breaks or SVG coordinates so that it does not depend on them, and every font-dependent outcome is listed as allowed.

mustNotFire.why: running element: Paged.js clones it into a page margin box on every page (position: running). A margin-box copy is not a fragment of the document flow; no layout rule may treat the copies as fragments of one block (docs/limitations.md 0.6.0: 'Blocks carrying the same source id are not always fragments of one flow').

allowed.why: where a block splits and how many lines each fragment carries depends on font metrics and on Chromium's own widows/orphans handling inside the Paged.js fragmentainer

expectedDeclines.docsBasis: docs/rules/layout-orphan.md 'Skipped after a forced outgoing break'; the widow rule declines after a forced incoming break (declines list in the rule registry).
